title: 第13章 薅师父羊毛只此一家别无分家第14章 灵猪圣体搬气八重天
content_zh:
那年四十二，站着如喽啰。
“许师弟，我不管，你知道我这段时间怎么度过的吗？”
许君白看着不断哀嚎的乞丐，是的，眼前这个披头散发的男子，身上一股味道，比大公猪身上的味道都要让人难闻，仿佛是掉进了茅坑里面一个月不洗澡的那种感觉，这酸爽，十分……
仔细看乞丐的脸蛋，许君白认出了眼前的男人，不正是自己下山送信的宋真罗宋师兄吗？
“这一路上，我被人抢劫，和人生死搏斗，碰到过妖兽，也杀过邪修，能做的，该做的，我都做了。”
“本以为去到飞仙宗能够好一点，谁知道，那个星罗真人不是人来的，呜呜呜，你不知道他怎么对待你师兄，我可怜的身躯，我那守身如玉的清白，呜呜呜。”
总结起来，就是一句话，加钱。
许君白抱着手，安静听着师兄的经历，十分精彩，也十分凄惨。
内心，不禁升起了一抹同情。
“师兄，辛苦你了。”
加钱是不可能加钱的，这辈子都不可能。
许君白可不会轻易加钱，你遭遇的灾难那是你的问题，你要是聪明一点，可能不用遭遇这些困难。
咳咳咳，如果是许君白下山，可能，还在去飞仙宗的半路。
这些话，他自然是不能说出来。
“许师弟，你当真如此绝情？”
“宋师兄，要不，你先去洗漱一番？”
宋真罗师兄闻言，嗅了嗅自身的味道，想吐了。
迅速离开，半个时辰后，他回来了，回归了原来的俊朗中年郎。
“许师弟，至少要加钱三分之一，否则，对不起师兄这一年多的悲惨。”
“宋师兄，你知道这是不可能的，师弟很同情你的遭遇，可这个价格是我们当初说好的，不能更改。”

说着，许君白拿出了一份合约，上面可是有宋真罗师兄的手印和气息。
当初为了防备这一幕，许君白做好了准备，可不会给宋真罗师兄讹诈的机会。
“许师弟，你这样子可就没意思了，你会失去我这个师兄的。”
许君白把剩下的灵药递给宋真罗师兄，看到他如此凄惨，算了，谁让他许君白是个善良的人呢，就给你多加一株灵药吧。
是的，没错，就是一株灵药。
不能再多了。
宋真罗师兄看着眼前的一株灵药，抬头，恶狠狠询问：“师弟，你打发乞丐呢？”
“你要不要？宋师兄，不要的话师弟可要收走了。”
“要，怎么可能不要。”
宋真罗师兄手速很快，全部藏在自己的储物袋里，那可是好东西，一株灵药也是钱，可不能不要。
“你的信。”
content_en:
That year, I was forty-two, standing like a slave.
"Junior Brother Xu, I don't care, do you know how I spent this time?"
Xu Junbai looked at the beggar who kept wailing. Yes, the disheveled man in front of him had a smell that was more unpleasant than the smell of a big boar. It was as if he had fallen into a latrine and not taken a shower for a month. It was so sour and refreshing...
Looking carefully at the beggar's face, Xu Junbai recognized the man in front of him. Isn't it none other than Senior Brother Song Zhenluosong who had come down from the mountain to deliver the message?
" Along the way, I was robbed, fought life and death, encountered monsters, and killed evil cultivators. I did everything I could and should do."
"I thought it would be better to go to Feixian Sect, but who knew that Master Xingluo was not a human being, woo woo, you don't know how he treats your senior brother, my pitiful body, and my innocence that is as guarded as jade, woo woo."
To sum it up, in one sentence, add money.
Xu Junbai held his hands and listened quietly to his senior brother's experience, which was both wonderful and tragic.
In my heart, I couldn't help but feel a sense of sympathy.
"Senior brother, thank you for your hard work."
It is impossible to add money, not even in this life.
Xu Junbai will not add money easily. The disaster you encounter is your problem. If you are smarter, you may not have to encounter these difficulties.
Ahem, if Xu Junbai came down the mountain, he might still be on the way to Feixian Sect.
Naturally, he couldn't say these words.
"Junior Brother Xu, are you really so heartless?"
"Senior Brother Song, how about you go wash up first?"
When Senior Brother Song Zhenluo heard this, he smelled his own scent and felt like vomiting.
He left quickly, and half an hour later, he came back, back to his original handsome middle-aged man.
"Junior Brother Xu, you must increase the amount by at least one-third. Otherwise, I will be sorry for the misery that Senior Brother has suffered over the past year."
"Senior Brother Song, you know this is impossible. Junior Brother sympathizes with your experience, but this price was agreed upon at the beginning and cannot be changed."
As he said that, Xu Junbai took out a contract, which had the fingerprints and aura of Senior Brother Song Zhenluo on it.
In order to prepare for this scene, Xu Junbai was well prepared and would not give Senior Brother Song Zhenluo a chance to blackmail him.
"Junior Brother Xu, it's not fun for you to be like this. You will lose me as your senior brother."
Xu Junbai handed the remaining elixir to Senior Brother Song Zhenluo. Seeing how miserable he was, forget it. Who told him that Xu Junbai was a kind person? I'll give you one more elixir.
Yes, that's right, it's a magical elixir.
No more.
Senior brother Song Zhenluo looked at the elixir in front of him, raised his head, and asked fiercely: "Junior brother, are you sending away the beggar?"
"Do you want it? Senior Brother Song, if you don't want it, Junior Brother will take it away."
"Yes, how could I not want to?"
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo was very quick and hid everything in his storage bag. It was a good thing. A spiritual medicine was also money, so he couldn't do without it.
"Your letter."
